name: Files
description: Fcode source-owned file editor. Fork of pi.file-manager v0.5.2 (MIT, Tioit-Wang) with distinct plugin identity, dirty-draft recovery, and source ownership.

en.name: Files
en.description: Browse, view and edit the open project in the right work panel: a full directory tree with per-file-type icons, syntax-highlighted editing, a Markdown preview, image and media viewing, CSV/JSON structured views, read-only SQLite browsing, a context menu for creating and renaming, filename search, multi-folder switching, host-driven open requests, and dirty-draft recovery after crash or plugin reload.
en.safetyNotes: Databases opened strictly read-only. fs.read declared only for host-mediated open/reveal actions. Plugin reads and writes go through Node fs inside plugin process; host permission gateway does not mediate these. Root-relative paths confined to the selected registered folder root (symlink/junction escapes refused; credential paths denied). Atomic write (temp+rename) and mtime+size conflict check on save. Recovered dirty drafts also check disk version before saving; a draft for a file that did not exist (expectedAbsent) refuses if the file was subsequently created.

zh-CN.name: 文件
zh-CN.description: 在右侧工作面板中浏览、查看并编辑当前项目的文件。pi.file-manager v0.5.2 的 Fcode 源码分支，加入 Fcode 专属标识、脏草稿恢复与源码所有权。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 数据库只读。路径包含限于当前选中的已注册 folder root。原子写并冲突检测。恢复脏草稿时同样做冲突检测；expectedAbsent 草稿在文件已被创建时拒绝覆盖。
